property_summary: For any caller that is a contract which advertises support for the token and currently has zero tokenBalance, after calling airDrop the reference contract always increases that caller's tokenBalance by exactly 20; the mutant that adds 40 will sometimes make the final balance different (e.g. 40) and thus violate this rule.
change_summary: Change the amount added in airDrop from 20 to 40 so callers receive different tokenBalance after the call.
